PV II · Golden Strategy Tree

The Mother Tree, version 3

Storms are the risks that bring the rain; the tree is the response that gives shelter and fruit. Economy grows on the left, people in the middle, governance on the right. Leaves are the 60 families every strategy is placed on; gold fruit are the pathways beneath them.

Storms
Plans by period: pick one to see its tree

Each column is one plan, oldest first; national plans, then the long-term strategy, then sector plans. A cell is the share of that plan's strategies placed on the family (hover for the count). Gold figures in the header rows are the share placed down at pathway level.

The whole tree

Every group, family and pathway, in the order of the canopy. Open a group to see its families; select a family to read it in the panel.
